measurement_timing: Source/build and independent census freeze first; independently derived profile/reserve seal before boundary scoring; separate owner B1 authorization prerequisite.
units: W = counted record/identity/coverage/receipt/edge/policy visits + ceil(total scheduled byte visits/1024). Count repeated passes and decoded node visits; preserve raw counters, not just W.
verification_vs_resolution: Mode-A may reevaluate historical pure policies to verify original R/V. Charge and expose these as verification-only visits, with no admission callbacks, new episode/choice/receiving/effects or publication. New-request resolver/application/Choice counters are separate, fixed before scoring; O3 has zero new resolution. Relabeling fresh resolution as verification is forbidden. Accepted C1 _load.calculate versus admit.resolutions illustrates the existing distinction.

passes.traversal: P01-P03 + every acknowledged anchor and original R/V exact comparison

independent_census: Reviewer decodes actual raw rows/files independently, traces candidate source loop bounds and simultaneous buffer lifetimes, counts each pass occurrence/byte/node/edge/SQL/page/object peak, and compares production estimator against independent totals. No product estimate reused as expected.
workspace: max(writer-visible page_count*page_size, actual allocated DB bytes) + complete rollback journal + temp/staging/checkpoint/external required artifact bytes + independent pending commit/reopen reserve; do not subtract freelist. Measure every physical copy. Free space qualification separately; no whole-volume/ACL guarantee.
postallocation_rule: P09 follows final allocation-changing SQL for root/ordinary/checkpoint including G8 publication/receipts/index. No SQL mutation after P09; required late mutation aborts and repeats complete prospective/P08/P09 in private transaction, never commit unmeasured growth.
boundary: Each of 11 caps separately: same shape operation under preauthorized independent profile cap W-1 O4, W and W+1 O1/O2, all other caps slack. Profiles/root ids differ and are sealed before test; old 0.1.2 fixed cap untouched. Initial oversized root has no world; rejected later growth preserves last safe acknowledged cold-readable head.
